tables.title: Sleep mode
tables.text: Table 56, "Sleep mode", in section 8.7.4 (Sleep mode) on page 235. Columns: Sleep mode, Description. 4 data row(s).

rows:
WFI (wait for interrupt) or WFE (wait for event) while:
–SLEEPDEEP=0
–No interrupt (for WFI) or event (for WFE) pending
Refer to the Cortex-M33 system control register.

On return from ISR while:
–SLEEPDEEP=0 and
–SLEEPONEXIT=1
–No interrupt pending
Refer to the Cortex-M33 system control register.

If WFI or Return from ISR was used for entry
Interrupt (see Table100: STM32C5 vector table)
If WFE was used for entry and SEVONPEND=0:
Wake-up event (see Section16.3: EXTI functional description
If WFE was used for entry and SEVONPEND=1:
Interrupt even when disabled in NVIC (see Table100: STM32C5 vector table) or wake-up event 
(see Section16.3: EXTI functional description)
